title: Read and change a clearance rule's pair value
summary: Shows how to find a design rule on a board with a board iterator, cast it to IPCB_ClearanceConstraint and read or set the clearance for one pair of object kinds, with Gap and Mode reported before and after.
phrasings: change the arc to track clearance of a design rule
find a clearance rule by name on a PCB
iterate design rules on a board
set a per-object clearance in the clearance matrix

commands.name: ChangeClearance
commands.description: Multiply the Arc-to-Track clearance of a clearance rule
commands.params: Rule=<rule name, default Clearance>|Factor=<positive number, default 3>
